title: Day and part of the day

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To say exactly when, put the day first, then the part of the day, then the place and the verb: *Hétfőn reggel tanulunk.* *Szombaton délután a parkban sétálunk.* Ask with *Mikor?*: *Mikor főztök? – Pénteken este.* *Hétvége* (weekend) takes the same ending as the days, and its final *e* lengthens to *é*: *hétvégén*.

sections.title: Day, part of the day, verb
rows: On Thursday at noon we have lunch.

items.english: When do you all shop? – On Saturday afternoon.
At the weekend we are at home.
On Sunday morning we do not wake up early.

sections.content: The verb ending already says who: *tanulunk* is “we”, so you can leave out *mi*. Use the same *-unk/-ünk* ending in every clause: *Hétfőn tanulunk, szombaton pihenünk.*
